spectators.label: Cardboard samurai
spectators.look: proud kid in homemade samurai armor made of red-painted cardboard plates tied with yellow string, a cardboard helmet with a gold paper fan-shaped crest, black sweatpants, sneakers, a plastic toy katana in a black sheath
spectators.idle: hand on the toy sword hilt, chest out
spectators.shocked: cardboard helmet slipping over his eyes

spectators.label: Shadow ninja fan
spectators.look: fan in a full black shinobi outfit with a black hood and face mask showing only the eyes, a long dark-gray headband tied at the back, black wrapped shins, split-toe black boots, a plastic kunai on his belt
spectators.idle: holding a ninja hand-sign at his chest
spectators.cheer: flinging a paper shuriken, other arm up
spectators.shocked: face mask slipping down, revealing a gaping mouth

spectators.label: Kunoichi with war fans
spectators.look: kunoichi cosplayer with a high purple ponytail and a long red scarf trailing behind; short purple wrap top with a black sash, black leggings, wrapped forearms, ankle tabi boots, two folding war fans
spectators.idle: hand on her hip, one fan held closed
spectators.cheer: both fans spread open in a pose
spectators.shocked: fans snapping shut, scarf flying up

spectators.label: Wandering ronin cosplayer
spectators.look: scruffy ronin cosplayer with a long unkempt black topknot and stubble under a battered straw hat; worn gray kimono over dark hakama trousers, straw sandals, a wooden sword at his hip and a sake gourd on a cord
spectators.cheer: gourd raised out to the side in a toast
spectators.shocked: straw hat tipping back, gourd spilling

spectators.label: Kid ninja
spectators.look: tiny kid ninja in a red-and-yellow ninja costume with a too-big red hood and face mask, a yellow sash, red split-toe socks, a handful of plastic shuriken
spectators.cheer: tossing plastic shuriken in the air
spectators.shocked: hood flopping down over his whole face

spectators.label: Long-nosed goblin mask cosplayer
spectators.look: cosplayer of a mountain goblin spirit with a red long-nosed mask and a small black cap; white mountain-ascetic robe with big fluffy pom-pom tassels on the sash, checkered vest, high geta, a feather fan
spectators.idle: slowly fanning with the feather fan
spectators.shocked: red mask tipping up to reveal a startled face

spectators.label: Armored samurai fan
spectators.look: big fan in a full replica suit of lacquered blue-and-gold samurai armor with layered shoulder plates, a helmet with tall golden horn-shaped crests and a black face guard pushed up, black armored boots
spectators.idle: arms folded across the chest plate
spectators.cheer: armored arms thrown out to the sides

spectators.label: Fox-mask festival ninja
spectators.look: teen girl in a white fox mask with red markings pushed to the side of her head, short dark-blue hair; dark-blue ninja outfit with a red sash, black leggings, a clear festival bag holding a goldfish
spectators.idle: holding up the goldfish bag, watching
spectators.cheer: jumping with the goldfish bag held high
spectators.shocked: fox mask sliding over her face

spectators.label: Feudal-lord cosplayer
spectators.look: portly middle-aged man cosplaying a feudal lord in a purple formal robe with wide stiff shoulder wings, gray pleated trousers, a fake black topknot wig, a red-and-gold paddle-shaped war fan
spectators.idle: posing grandly with the war fan at his chest
spectators.cheer: war fan pointed at the ring, commanding
spectators.shocked: topknot wig flying off his head

spectators.label: Woman warrior with polearm
spectators.look: tall woman-warrior cosplayer with long black hair tied in a low ponytail and a white headband; white kimono top with red cords tying back the sleeves, red pleated hakama trousers, a short-handled wooden curved-blade polearm held upright
spectators.idle: polearm held upright beside her, serene
spectators.cheer: polearm thrust out to the side, battle cry

spectators.label: Grandpa ninja
spectators.look: spry little grandpa in a baggy moss-green ninja costume with the mask pulled down under his chin, bushy white eyebrows and mustache, a black round smoke-bomb ball in his hand
spectators.cheer: tossing the smoke ball up with a small gray puff
spectators.shocked: coughing in a small gray smoke puff

spectators.label: Foot-soldier cosplayer
spectators.look: earnest foot-soldier cosplayer in a flat conical black lacquer hat, simple brown lamellar chest armor over a blue tunic, wrapped shins, a short narrow white banner with a plain black diamond on a pole strapped to his back
spectators.cheer: fist pumped, banner wobbling on his back

spectators.label: Cyber-ninja cosplayer
spectators.look: cosplayer in a futuristic ninja suit of silver armor plates over a black bodysuit with glowing neon-cyan lines, a cyan LED visor across the eyes, a light-up toy katana glowing cyan
spectators.idle: light-up katana resting on his shoulder
